messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: algebraic number field construction optimizing 3x3 determinant spectra

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square for maximizing the minimum triangle area is obtained by taking 13 points whose coordinates are algebraic integers in the degree-12 number field generated by a root of the polynomial x^12 - x^10 + 2x^8 - 3x^6 + x^4 - x^2 + 1, selected so that the spectrum of absolute values of all 286 possible 3×3 determinants has its minimum element maximized at exactly 1/144, with the extremal configuration realizing a structured determinant spectrum where the 12 smallest determinant values form two arithmetic progressions of length 6 with common difference 1/864."}
